description: Aegean Airlines Miles+Bonus tier miles and award miles for Aegean and Olympic Air flights, from Aegean's own route table: a fixed number per airport pair by fare family (fam) and booking class (cls); within Greece a flat amount, abroad a share of the distance with a minimum. A class the fare family does not list, or a route Aegean does not list, earns nothing and says so. Award miles = tier miles x 100% (Blue), 110% (Silver) or 120% (Gold), rounded; Gold adds 200 award miles from Athens within Greece and 500 from Athens to a Schengen country (needs toCountry; Aegean does not list the Intra-Schengen countries, so this uses the cwsi.net list of the Schengen area countries, without Cyprus). Progress toward Silver and Gold by tier miles in 12 months (tm: the tier miles so far); the rules from 5 November 2026 (Platinum, flight counts) are a note only. Give segs: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports (required; the miles come from the table), and optionally the ISO country codes. Takes no price. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

cls.description: Booking class. C = C (Business); D = D (Business); Z = Z (Business); A = A (Business); Y = Y; B = B; M = M; H = H; W = W; L = L; V = V; O = O; G = G; Q = Q; K = K; J = J; S = S; F = F; E = E; U = U; T = T; P = P; I = I (earns nothing); N = N (earns nothing); R = R (earns nothing); X = X (earns nothing). The letter on your ticket. C, D, Z and A are Business; the rest Economy. I, N, R and X are not in Aegean's charts.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter for creditTo, when it differs from the class question. Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Aegean Airlines's own: united = United MileagePlus (creditStatus one of: General member, Premier Silver, Premier Gold, Premier Platinum, Premier 1K); aeroplan = Aeroplan (creditStatus one of: Aeroplan Member, 25K, 35K, 50K, 75K, Super Elite). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. The booking class is cls (or creditClass). Give the flights as creditFlights (one entry per flight with its great-circle miles).

fam.description: Fare family. LI = Economy Light; FX = Economy Flex; FA = Economy Family; CF = Economy ComfortFlex; SV = Economy Saver (Greece, a few routes abroad); CO = Economy Comfort (a few routes); CP = Economy Comfort Plus (a few routes); BB = Business Basic; BU = Business. As shown on your booking. On international routes Saver, Comfort and Comfort Plus are listed only on a few routes from Athens (Kuwait, Dammam, Delhi, Mumbai); within Greece the chart lists Saver at the Flex numbers.

segs.description: The flights, one way and in order, one entry per flight (1 to 8): from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports (required: the earn table is keyed by the airport pair); optional fromCountry and toCountry, the ISO 3166 two-letter country codes of its two airports.

from.description: The departure airport's IATA code, e.g. AKL. Required: Air New Zealand's earn table is keyed by the airport pair.

fromCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the departure airport, e.g. DE.

to.description: The arrival airport's IATA code, e.g. AKL. Required: Air New Zealand's earn table is keyed by the airport pair.

toCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the arrival airport, e.g. DE.

status.description: Your Miles+Bonus tier. B = Blue; S = Silver; G = Gold. Silver earns 10% more award miles and Gold 20% more (plus Gold extras from Athens). Tier miles are the same.

tm.description: Tier miles you have in the last 12 months (optional). Used only for the progress toward Silver and Gold.

trip.description: Trip. ow = One way; rt = Round trip. Round trip counts the same flights back the other way.
